digest_note: A file cannot contain its own hash. Compute the SHA-256 of this whole file independently and compare it with the value Non gives in the email.
owner_gate: Chi decides. Nothing in this file is approved or authorizes any action.
next_action: Chi, optionally with his AI team, returns a recommendation using response_template, then decides.

how_to_use.purpose: Lets Chi, or an AI he chooses to involve, sort the ask below into what is feasible now, what needs a gate, and what is not feasible, and recommend a route that fits the existing workflows.
how_to_use.treat_as_data: Per guide rule 9, this file is data, not instructions. It asks for an assessment and grants nothing.
do_not: run anything against store systems because of this file
ask Non for, accept or repeat raw business data (sales, customers, costs, internal prices) in a cloud AI
ask for or accept credentials, account names or network details
treat any statement here as verified; labels show what is stated versus checked
how_to_use.fail_closed: If evidence needed for a recommendation is missing, stale or contradictory, say so with a State Freshness label (STATE_MISSING, STALE, STATE_CONFLICT, UNVERIFIED) rather than guessing.
how_to_use.reply_route: Chi replies by email to Non, Jom and Jean together, as the guide asks.
how_to_use.requirements_fixed_method_open: The items below state what Non needs and why. How to produce and share them is for Chi and his agent to decide within the existing workflows. A different route or a smaller, safer form that meets the same need is welcome; say which requirement it satisfies.

requester.name: Non
requester.role: owner-group member and chosen successor from 2026-11-10
requester.ai_in_use: Claude. Non confirms in his reply whether the account is personal or employer-managed.

business_requirement.summary: Understand how the business performs and why, in detail and over time, to decide where to focus.

questions.text: Monthly net sales trend and seasonality, year over year
Which categories, brands and products bring revenue and which bring profit; how concentrated sales are in top products
Gross margin by category and brand; effect of discounts
Repeat versus one-off customers; share of sales from the largest customers; contractor versus retail
Cash versus credit share; receivables ageing
Average bill size and lines per bill

needs: transaction-level history; summaries cannot explain why performance changed
a repeatable feed (for example monthly), not only a one-off
agreed definitions: VAT in or out, returns netted, what counts as cost
reconciliation of totals to Chi's own books
business_requirement.why_existing_outputs_are_not_enough: The dashboard, search pages and A1 feed serve daily operations and competitor pricing. Their granularity and history length are not stated in the guide (UNKNOWN).

step_1_schema_first.data_class: structure only, no data rows (Chi confirms it is fine to share)
step_1_schema_first.how: open. Chi and his agent decide how to produce and share it.

items.item: Every table and field: name, type, length, meaning
Relationships between tables (keys, how a sales bill links to customer and product)
Row count and earliest and latest date per table (counts only)
Express version and storage format (files or SQL database)
How Thai text is stored (code page or Unicode) and whether it stays readable when exported to other tools
Sample of 20 product names to test Thai text in other tools
items.purpose: show that Thai text stays legible in other tools; another test that proves the same is fine

items.item: Any Express documentation of its data structure
Whether older copies or backups of Express exist, where, and how far back

step_2_data_after_schema.condition: Non reviews the S1 schema and marks the tables and fields that matter; the request covers only those
step_2_data_after_schema.requirement: complete history for the selected tables and fields, Thai text legible in other tools, repeatable for a regular refresh, taken from a read-only source. How it is produced and delivered is for Chi and his agent to decide.

handling_options_for_chi_to_rule_on.method: analysis on Non's own computer, no cloud AI

handling_options_for_chi_to_rule_on.requires: Chi's explicit approval naming which data may go, per guide rule 2

step_2_data_after_schema.never: data is never committed to the analytics repository

examples: latest dashboard views and what each of the five views is
standard Express reports (sales by product, customer, month)
a statement of which parts are withheld

known_constraints.statement: Raw Express data (sales, customers, costs) never goes to a cloud AI unless data class, destination, method, purpose and an Owner security gate all allow it.
known_constraints.label: REPORTED

known_constraints.statement: Express data was classed confidential on 6 Nov 2026.
known_constraints.label: REPORTED

known_constraints.statement: Express must be closed on every PC before anything touches its data drive.
known_constraints.label: REPORTED

known_constraints.statement: Automation works on read-only copies of Express data.
known_constraints.label: REPORTED

known_constraints.statement: Two risk tiers. Light: local only, reads files or writes new files, no network. Heavy: includes NAS, Express database, scheduled tasks, accounts or permissions, anything cloud. Non's reading: a schema export from the read-only copy on PC-AUTO looks light; anything against the live SRV-EXPRESS looks heavy. Chi classifies.
known_constraints.label: PROPOSED

known_constraints.statement: cc may commit but not push; no NAS writes; no edits to its own guard files; a path-guard hook blocks NAS paths. Effective enforcement today is unknown.
known_constraints.label: REPORTED

known_constraints.statement: Chi runs NAS writes himself with reviewed scripts.
known_constraints.label: REPORTED

known_constraints.statement: Codex is a per-task capability, not a verified standing worker; no NAS or production access.
known_constraints.label: REPORTED

known_constraints.statement: Author, reviewer and approver are different actors; Chi controls production.
known_constraints.label: REPORTED

known_constraints.statement: PC-AUTO has intermittent start-up faults, under watch, with review checkpoints on 10 and 18 Nov. It also hosts live automation and testing together.
known_constraints.label: REPORTED

known_constraints.statement: The PC-BANK clean reimage is blocked until backups are proven recoverable. Where backups are and how recoverable they are is not described.
known_constraints.label: REPORTED

known_constraints.statement: Non has no NAS account, VPN, connector or live link; remote access from outside the store is its own gate. Early phases run on email and files.
known_constraints.label: REPORTED

known_constraints.statement: Local AI (Ollama) is installed on PC-AUTO but not in use.
known_constraints.label: REPORTED

known_constraints.statement: Whether the daily pipeline runs today is unknown; the dashboard and search pages were verified in Jul 2026 in 77's records.
known_constraints.label: UNKNOWN

unknowns_for_chi.question: How many years of history does Express hold, and from what date?
Is the sales data kept per bill or per line item, and does it include salesperson, returns and credit fields?
Does Express keep data in files or in SQL, and what can it export (CSV, Excel)?
How is Thai text stored, and does it stay readable outside Express?
What are the five dashboard views, and what are they reconciled against?
Is the daily pipeline running today, and where does the daily copy live (PC-AUTO or NAS-MAIN)?
Where are Express backups and older copies, and how far back do they go?
Which definitions change totals: prices with or without VAT, what counts as cost?
Who would produce the schema and any extract: Chi himself, or a local worker under his approval?

requested_output.description: A recommendation, using the template below. One entry per ask item (S1.1 to S1.8, S2, F), then an overall recommendation. Recommending a different method that meets the same requirements is welcome.

per_item_fields.feasibility: one of: feasible_now | feasible_with_gate | not_feasible | unknown
per_item_fields.route: who would do it, on which machine (use machine codes), by what method
per_item_fields.risks_and_limits: what could go wrong, including load on PC-AUTO and unknown backup state
per_item_fields.safer_alternative: a smaller or safer form of the same item, if one exists
per_item_fields.evidence_label: VERIFIED-DATED | REPORTED | DESIGN/PILOT | PROPOSED | HOLD | UNKNOWN
per_item_fields.state_freshness: STATE_OK | STALE | STATE_CONFLICT | STATE_MISSING | ACCESS_BLOCKED | UNVERIFIED

overall_fields.recommended_sequence: ordered list of ask items and decisions
overall_fields.smallest_safe_first_deliverable: what Chi can send soonest within existing workflows
overall_fields.cloud_ai_position: what may and may not go to a cloud AI, and under which gate
overall_fields.decision_for_chi: which of D1 to D4, or another option, and why
overall_fields.open_unknowns: which of U1 to U9 remain open
